The team's head coach was [[Bruce Pearl]] in his 5th season at Auburn. The team played their home games at the [[Auburn Arena]] in [[Auburn, Alabama]]. They finished the season 30–10, 11–7 in SEC play. They defeated [[2018–19 Missouri Tigers men's basketball team|Missouri]], [[2018–19 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|South Carolina]], [[2018–19 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]], and [[2018–19 Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball team|Tennessee]] to win the [[2019 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]]. They received an automatic bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2018–19 New Mexico State Aggies men's basketball team|New Mexico State]], [[2018–19 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]], [[2018–19 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]], and [[2018–19 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] to advance to their first Final Four in school history where they lost 63–62 to the eventual champions [[2018–19 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/auburn/2019-schedule.html|title=2018-19 Auburn Tigers Schedule and Results|accessdate=18 April 2019}} == Previous season == [[2017–18 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 26–8, 13–5 in SEC play to win a share of the SEC regular season championship. They lost to [[2017–18 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 College of Charleston Cougars men's basketball team|College of Charleston]] to advance to the Second Round where they lost to [[2017–18 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/auburn/2018-schedule.html|title=2017-18 Auburn Tigers Schedule and Results|accessdate=18 April 2019}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
